limitations: One fresh launch per app workload; no controlled revision A/B.

Final candidate: 1 MB footprint 112.4/123.4 MiB versus a single 102.5 MiB control; stress pair 113.5/88.8/114.5 MiB versus a single 85.8 MiB control. Small-workload baseline distributions are not established; do not claim uniform memory savings or attribute all variation to this patch.

markerBatching.method: Shared 1 pt monospaced marker font; grouped equal-advance kern writes; ordered marker overlay/content-run merge; autorelease pools outside batches of 1024 markers and 16384 UTF-16 units; compact retained span array. No allocator relief API. Per-pass full-NSFont-keyed bold/italic conversion reuse.

regressions.goldensChanged: 14 rendered-lens invisible-marker probes add the monospaced trait; visible probes and Markdown-lens goldens unchanged.
regressions.finalReleaseTimingNote: Xcode reports overlapping 30.76-second host wall durations for all three concurrent main-actor tests; use the in-test 12-second style guard, not that duration, as performance proof.

markerBatching.acceptance: Repeatable large-document latency improvement, modest 5 MB physical-footprint improvement. Uniform footprint acceptance not established: 1 MB settled footprint increased; stress pair varied across fresh launches. No Sentry hang resolution claimed.
